chunks: Will have the Abyss for abode.

key_terms.هَاوِيَةٌ: The Abyss; a deep, bottomless pit in Hell

ai.seo_question: What does 'Hawiyah' mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'Hawiyah' is often interpreted not merely as a location but as the ultimate destination of those whose spiritual roots are severed from divine guidance, emphasizing the totality of their fall. This verse serves as a poignant conclusion to Surah Al-Qari'ah, contrasting the eternal peace of the righteous with the abyssal despair of the disbelievers, a concept further elaborated in traditions regarding the levels of Jahannam.
